reasons: Rule applicability confirmed: this is a master services agreement whose termination section (p0032–p0033) addresses only notice, accrued fees and assignment of Works, with no transition assistance, data/materials return, or deletion obligation — a genuine TRANSITION gap (missing), correctly flagged as medium severity.

The inserted § 6(c) tracks the playbook model language precisely (six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification) and is directionally correct in the customer's favor.
The edit is minimal and additive — no changes to existing paragraphs — and is placed in the correct location (immediately after the termination provisions).

Defined terms are adapted appropriately to this Agreement (Company, Contractor, Works, Confidential Information) because 'Customer Data' is undefined here; the added 'Company data' phrasing preserves the intended scope without creating an undefined capitalized term.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, explains the reason for the insertion, states the preferred position and offers the 90-day fallback.

Deterministic checks pass (operation applies; data return/transition language present); minor scope broadening to Statements of Work and to Confidential Information is reasonable and not a substantive defect.
